about: Limits the Fusion Parameters Panel shows under a parameter when its value breaks them. They warn, never block: an experiment may test past a rule on purpose. Each limit is a Fusion expression over the design's user parameters; a rule whose parameter or names the open design lacks is skipped.

rules.reason: keeps 1.6 mm of air between the skin and the tape land at the edge
rules.source: hex-tile skill: nothing within 1.6 mm of the skin. The gap is edge_depth - skin_axial - land_thickness at the edge and grows inward (RIFT export at edge_depth 9: 4.8 mm, 4 mm in from a corner; tests/test_design_rules.py)
